apps.name: BattAI: Battery health score
apps.summary: BattAI BattAI uses five values from public iOS APIs: battery level, charge state, Low Power Mode, whole-device thermal state, and time. Other results are calculated from those readings or added by you. Each detail shows its source and limits.

apps.name: CalDaily: Calculator & Themes
apps.summary: A calculator you will actually keep using, because it remembers the thinking behind each number.

apps.name: CountDaysNow: Event Counter
apps.summary: Plan backwards from the dates that matter. Countdown Plan gives any event its own preparation steps, such as renew the passport 30 days before a trip or order the cake 7 days before a birthday, and shows what is late, due today, due in the next 7 days and done across all your events.

apps.name: CV Desk: ATS CV Builder
apps.summary: Build an ATS-ready CV that recruiter systems can actually read — entirely on your iPhone. No account, no uploads and no subscription.

apps.name: Cyca: Period & Cycle Tracker
apps.summary: Meet Cyca — a calm, private way to understand your cycle.

apps.name: DailyMate: Everyday Phrases
apps.summary: Know the words but still freeze mid-conversation? DailyMate teaches complete sentences and the natural replies that follow, so you learn what people really say rather than lists of single words. Choose from 8,400 practical phrases in 47 learning languages, organised into 14 everyday topics and 84 real-life situations, from greetings, food and shopping to work, health and travel. A Home Screen widget and a watch app keep one phrase in front of you all day. One purchase. No subscription.

apps.name: DailyMate Lite: Speak Today
apps.summary: Be ready when it is your turn to speak. DailyMate Lite turns everyday situations into short cue-and-reply practice in 50 languages. Start free with the Travel topic at Beginner level, then unlock the full library with one purchase. No subscription.

apps.name: dB Halo: Sound Level Meter
apps.summary: Whether you are keeping an eye on building works, a noisy flat, the commute or a rehearsal room, dB Halo gives you a clear view of the sound around you while processing stays on your devices. The large Halo safety ring shows live dB at a glance, alongside minimum, average, maximum and peak readings and a time-stamped event log. Select A, C or Z weighting, use an external microphone and save several calibration profiles for different setups.

apps.name: EasyAM: Workday Alarm Clock
apps.summary: Will your alarm go off tomorrow, and should it? EasyAM works it out for you: it rings on working days and stays quiet on bank holidays and your days off, so you can stop switching alarms off and on again. EasyAM opens on your next seven days, or 14 on iPad: which mornings will ring, and when.

apps.name: Foldable Wallpaper Studio
apps.summary: One wallpaper rarely fits both screens of a foldable, so Foldable Wallpaper Studio makes pairs: a close-up for the tall cover screen and the full panorama for the wide inner screen, cut from the same scene. Every pair is designed for iPhone Duo and saved at exact pixel sizes, so each image fits its screen exactly.

apps.name: G+Money: Spending & Budget
apps.summary: G+Money is two everyday tools in one — a lightning-fast currency converter and a beautiful expense tracker — built for daily life and travel alike. Fully offline. Completely private.

apps.name: G+Money Lite: Trip Spending
apps.summary: G+Money Lite — Smart travel currency & expense tracker

apps.name: GBAGo: Visual Saves

apps.name: HoursTag Lite: Price in Hours

apps.name: HoursTag: Hours to Buy

apps.name: LED Moving Text
apps.summary: Cue Flow handles moments that need more than one sign. Put one message on each line, then step backward or forward live, or choose a 2–20 second timer with optional repeat. Event crews, speakers and queues get a prepared run of messages without leaving the full-screen board.

apps.name: LockHour Pro: Block Apps
apps.summary: Protect your best hours. LockHour Pro helps you commit to calm focus sessions, reduce phone distractions and build better work habits without clutter. It is made for study, deep work, writing, planning and any task that deserves your full attention.

apps.name: Lumi Bopomofo
apps.summary: A playful first step into Mandarin Chinese sounds. Lumi Bopomofo turns Zhuyin, the phonetic system used for Mandarin, into a charming planet-themed game for children aged 3–6. Short activities help young learners recognise symbols, sounds and combinations with confidence.

apps.name: Lumi Bopomofo Pro: Zhuyin
apps.summary: A playful first step into Mandarin Chinese sounds. Lumi Bopomofo Pro turns Zhuyin, the phonetic system used for Mandarin, into a charming planet-themed game for children aged 3–6. Short activities help young learners recognise symbols, sounds and combinations with confidence.

apps.name: Lumi Letters Lite: ABC Kids
apps.summary: Start with the letter A and the first planet, then unlock the rest only if your family loves it. Lumi Letters Lite turns the English alphabet into a starry adventure for ages 3 to 7: children hear each letter's name and sound, practise letter formation by tracing capitals and lower-case letters along stroke guides, and collect cute letter friends. Gentle enough for nursery, reception and home learning. No adverts, and it works offline.

apps.name: Lumi Letters Pro: ABC Phonics
apps.summary: Real phonics for little learners: hear the sound, spot it in the word, trace the letter. Lumi Letters Pro takes children through 14 planets, 12 question types and 26 collectable letter friends. They listen for the initial, middle and end sound of a word, match capital and lower-case letters, and trace every letter along stroke guides. In the Parent Zone you can follow progress across four core skills and print a daily worksheet. No ads, no subscription, no data collection, and it works offline, ideal for nursery, reception and home learning.

apps.name: Lumi Math Planet: Explorer
apps.summary: Solve a question and a little planet lights up. Lumi Math Planet turns counting, number bonds, addition, subtraction, times tables, clocks and money into a gentle space adventure for the early school years, with 46 question types shown in pictures and read aloud. Parents can follow progress, practise weak spots and print worksheets with answer keys. No ads, no subscription.

apps.name: Lumi Math Pro: Kids Numbers
apps.summary: Turn real mathematical thinking into a gentle space adventure. Lumi Math Pro helps children aged 3–6 practise counting, number sense, addition, patterns, shapes and logic through short, playful challenges.

apps.name: Lumi Mission Planet: Chores
apps.summary: Turn everyday routines into gentle wins for your child. Lumi Mission Planet helps children aged 3–6 practise brushing teeth, getting dressed, tidying up, bedtime steps and small chores through calm, playful missions. Stars celebrate effort and build confidence without adverts, pressure or noisy distractions.

apps.name: Lumi Mission Planet Pro
apps.summary: Turn everyday routines into gentle wins for your child. Lumi Mission Planet helps children aged 3–6 practise brushing teeth, getting dressed, tidying up, bedtime steps and small chores through calm, playful missions. Stars celebrate effort and build confidence without adverts, pressure or noisy distractions.

apps.name: Lumi Weather: What to Wear
apps.summary: Lumi Weather tells you in one glance whether now is a good time to go outside, what to wear, and whether you need an umbrella or sun cream.

apps.name: Mask My File: Remove Your Info
apps.summary: Share safely without losing the context people genuinely need. Mask My File finds private details before you send a file, permanently hides only what you choose, then reopens and verifies the new copy before it shows Private Ready.

apps.name: Mochi: Cute Checklist
apps.summary: Mochi makes everyday planning feel cute, calm and beautifully simple. Add your tasks, tap the little circle when something is done, and enjoy the gentle satisfaction of bringing order to your day.

apps.name: Mochi DoneStamp: Last Time
apps.summary: When did you last change the sheets, water a plant, ring family, back up photos, or replace a filter?

apps.name: MoneyTag: Income & Expenses

apps.name: OnePage PPT: AI Slide Maker

apps.name: PhotoCream Pro: Film Filters
apps.summary: PhotoCream Pro turns your phone into a film camera: watch grain, halation and light leaks appear live before you press the shutter. Choose from 100+ authentic film looks, copy the colours of any photo, retouch skin and fine-tune light, colour and curves in a full editor. Everything runs on your device, with no subscription and no ads, and your photos are never uploaded. Plus face slimming, eye enlargement, body lengthening and a date stamp just like on classic film prints.

apps.name: PicClear Pro: Photo Cleaner
apps.summary: Free up gigabytes by clearing out the photos you don’t need: duplicates, screenshots, blurry shots and space-hungry videos.

apps.name: QR Code Halo: Scan & Create
apps.summary: QR Code Halo acts as soon as it reads a code. Scan with the camera or choose a photo: links open in your browser, passkey sign-in codes and app links are passed straight to iOS, Wi-Fi codes bring up the iOS Join prompt, and calls, messages, email and places open in their own apps. Contacts and events open the iOS add screen so that you can confirm. Text is copied with a short note, and javascript:, data: or file: codes are never opened. To review each code first, switch off ‘Run action after scanning’ in Settings; batch scan only collects.

apps.name: SaveTag: AI Social Bookmarks
apps.summary: Save it now. Actually read it later.

apps.name: ScanTo Pro: Offline PDF OCR

apps.name: Sereno: Sleep & Relax

Rain, ocean, wind, fire and more are real field recordings, blended into 1000+ unique soundscapes and woven together at random as you listen — no fixed loop, just a gentle mix that carries you through the night.

apps.name: ShotInbox AI: Sort Screenshots

apps.name: Snapport Lite: Take ID Photos

apps.name: Sono Note: Voice to Text Notes

apps.name: Studydown: Face-Down Timer

apps.name: Unblurry Pro: Unblur & HD

apps.name: WiFi Aid Lite: Network Check

apps.name: Wordmate Lite: Vocabulary

Wordmate organises words in 44 languages into 14 practical topics and three levels, with an example sentence for every English word and spoken pronunciation. Revise on the train, in a queue or between meetings from the interactive Home Screen widget or the watch app. No subscription, no in-app purchases.

apps.name: Zipbox: Unzip RAR, ZIP & 7z
apps.summary: Zipbox is a paid App Store download. One purchase includes every feature, with no in-app purchases, subscriptions or adverts. All 13 formats are handled on your device.
